EmailTemplate.subject: Partner with the Red Cross to help save lives!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear [Insert Name],
I’m writing to invite your school to partner with the American Red Cross through our high school blood program. Your decision to host a Red Cross blood drive teaches your students the important role that blood donations play in ensuring a ready blood supply, which is critical to the treatment of cancer patients, accident victims and unforeseen trauma situations.
Benefits of a Red Cross High School Blood Program partnership: • A meaningful opportunity for your students to help save lives. • Educational presentation, curriculum or classroom activities for a student learn-in-action experience. • Leadership opportunities for students to take action by volunteering on a blood drive committee or giving blood at your blood drive. • Your school will be recognized for helping save lives, with the opportunity to earn a scholarship for your school to award to a student recipient!
I hope you will partner with the Red Cross for a lifesaving blood drive program which can help you accomplish this mission and bring students, faculty and the community together to help change someone’s life with every single donation you collect.
Contact me today and let’s save lives together.
Sincerely, [Insert Name]
P.S. Do you have friends or family who are involved in leading student organizations around your community that might be interested in a youth blood program? If so, please forward this email to encourage others to get involved!
